text: For seeds 20-21, the final force margin is roughly flat from N=16 to N=64 (0.24-0.28 vs 0.21-0.26) and then falls by about 0.1 per doubling (0.13-0.15 at N=128, 0.03-0.04 at N=256). Over the same range the accel_step and force random controls stay flat from N=64 to N=128. Does the force margin track the size of the m2-dependent (1+m2) factor in each snapshot's time step, (2*pi/N)^2, or the per-snapshot displacement? A linear probe for m2 at N=64/128/256 would test whether m2 decodability falls in step with force.
